requirement_to_evidence.property: Preservation references survive each rename unchanged by identity and file content where a hash exists.

requirement_to_evidence.property: A partial move is recoverable without blind replay or permanent deletion.

Receipt records the recovery rule to compare recorded device/inode at original and Trash paths and never rerun blindly.
requirement_to_evidence.result: PASS_STATIC_FOR_THE_IMPLEMENTED_OPERATOR_FLOW; recovery after interruption is an explicit manual step, not automatic rollback.

p38_divergence_and_closure.prior_proxy: A nonempty actual_run_provenance_git_refs list was previously enough, even when an ID had no exact retained Git object behind it.
p38_divergence_and_closure.divergent_case: A fabricated or stale nonempty ID (or a map entry with a wrong digest/length) could make the earlier presence-only gate green without binding actual evidence.
p38_divergence_and_closure.current_property_tested: Mover resolves each ID through git_run_provenance_ref_index, recomputes exact blob SHA-256 and length, and requires the same commit/path/digest/length tuple in retained_evidence_git_refs.
p38_divergence_and_closure.disposition: Same provenance-binding class widened once; current static path closes the nonempty-ID escape for resolved IDs. No dynamic removal-control was run in this read-only review.
p38_divergence_and_closure.residual: Git content binding proves which bytes are retained, not the truth of the execution claim inside those bytes; that remains owner-supplied evidence reviewed at root release.
